extraction.notes: Comparator extraction for RI-TEC-036 only (LIM-0026). Evidence base (pages 38-39, 42): official documents, freedom of information requests, three anonymous key informant interviews (two CSO directors, one CSO researcher), and a survey of 1026 citizens in February 2025. The seven sampled services are property, company and vehicle registration, passport, ID card, VAT declaration and VAT payment, so results are not for the portal as a whole. The survey asked how often people used e-services and which channel they prefer (statements 15 and 16, page 44), but the report does not publish those answers and did not use them for scoring (footnote 66): this report therefore holds no measure of use. Acknowledgements (page 4) name the National Agency for Information Society and the Ministry as partners; WeBER 3.0 is EU funded (page 5). Scores are not comparable with earlier editions (page 12). Not extracted: the staff training detail, the transparency of the Agency for Dialogue and Co-governance, and the comparison chart on page 34 whose values are not labelled in the text. Second pass by checker-I: see review/RUN-2026-01/run1b/second_pass/ALB-CSO-2025-001.csv.
